entries.label: MLAK
entries.description: Master Locksmiths Access Key: one key that opens accessible toilets, Changing Places and other facilities for people with disability. Sold to people who need it on proof of need.

entries.label: RADAR key
entries.description: The National Key Scheme key, known as the RADAR key, that opens accessible toilets in the United Kingdom.

osm.note: OSM names the scheme nks (National Key Scheme).

entries.label: Eurokey
entries.description: The Eurokey (Euroschlüssel) that opens accessible toilets and other facilities for people with disability, mainly in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
